mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS member_id, m.name AS member_name, DATE(ws.started_at) AS workout_date, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wset.exercise_name REGEXP '스쿼트|레그|런지|데드리프트|힙|카프' THEN '하체' WHEN wset.exercise_name REGEXP '벤치|체스트|푸시업|딥스|플라이|삼두|트라이셉스' THEN '가슴 + 삼두' WHEN wset.exercise_name REGEXP '로우|랫풀|풀업|등|이두|바이셉스' THEN '등 + 이두' WHEN wset.exercise_name REGEXP '숄더|어깨|레터럴|오버헤드' THEN '어깨' WHEN wset.exercise_name REGEXP '러닝|트레드밀|사이클|유산소' THEN '유산소' ELSE '기타' END ORDER BY ws.started_at SEPARATOR ', ') AS workout_summary, COUNT(DISTINCT wset.exercise_name) AS exercise_count, COUNT(wset.id) AS total_sets, MIN(ws.id) AS first_session_id FROM workout_sessions ws JOIN members m ON m.id = ws.member_id LEFT JOIN workout_sets wset ON wset.session_id = ws.id JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.member_id = m.id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN trainers t ON t.id = ta.trainer_id AND t.user_id = #{userId} WHERE (#{memberId} IS NULL OR m.id = #{memberId}) GROUP BY m.id, m.name, DATE(ws.started_at) ORDER BY workout_date DESC, m.name

SELECT ws.id AS session_id, m.id AS member_id, m.name AS member_name, ws.routine_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(ws.memo, '[[:space:]]*루틴.*$', ''), ''), wr.title, '개인 운동') AS routine_title, ws.started_at, ws.ended_at, wset.exercise_name, COUNT(wset.id) AS sets, MAX(wset.weight) AS weight, MAX(wset.reps) AS reps, ws.memo FROM workout_sessions ws JOIN members m ON m.id = ws.member_id LEFT JOIN workout_routines wr ON wr.id = ws.routine_id LEFT JOIN workout_sets wset ON wset.session_id = ws.id JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.member_id = m.id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN trainers t ON t.id = ta.trainer_id AND t.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.id = #{memberId} AND DATE(ws.started_at) = #{workoutDate} GROUP BY ws.id, m.id, m.name, ws.routine_id, wr.title, ws.started_at, ws.ended_at, ws.memo, wset.exercise_name ORDER BY ws.started_at, wset.exercise_name

SELECT ws.id AS session_id, m.id AS member_id, m.name AS member_name, ws.routine_id, COALESCE(wr.title, '개인 운동') AS routine_title, ws.started_at, ws.ended_at, MAX(wset.exercise_name) AS exercise_name, COUNT(wset.id) AS sets, MAX(wset.weight) AS weight, MAX(wset.reps) AS reps, ws.memo FROM workout_sessions ws JOIN members m ON m.id = ws.member_id LEFT JOIN workout_routines wr ON wr.id = ws.routine_id LEFT JOIN workout_sets wset ON wset.session_id = ws.id JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.member_id = m.id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN trainers t ON t.id = ta.trainer_id AND t.user_id = #{userId} WHERE ws.id = #{sessionId} GROUP BY ws.id, m.id, m.name, ws.routine_id, wr.title, ws.started_at, ws.ended_at, ws.memo

SELECT wset.exercise_name, COUNT(*) AS sets, MAX(wset.weight) AS weight, MAX(wset.reps) AS reps FROM workout_sets wset JOIN workout_sessions ws ON ws.id = wset.session_id JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.member_id = ws.member_id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN trainers t ON t.id = ta.trainer_id AND t.user_id = #{userId} WHERE ws.id = #{sessionId} GROUP BY wset.exercise_name ORDER BY MIN(wset.id)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workout_sessions(member_id, routine_id, started_at, ended_at, memo) VALUES(#{memberId}, #{routineId}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{memo})
mapper.update: UPDATE workout_sessions SET routine_id = #{routineId}, started_at = #{startedAt}, ended_at = #{endedAt}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE ws FROM workout_sessions ws JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.member_id = ws.member_id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN trainers t ON t.id = ta.trainer_id WHERE ws.id = #{sessionId} AND t.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workout_sets(session_id, exercise_name, set_number, weight, reps, completed) VALUES(#{sessionId}, #{exerciseName}, #{setNumber}, #{weight}, #{reps}, TRUE)
